split: leave one model_id out; one-GPU/two-core probes only on selected conditions
method: ridge anchor residual transfer then anchor-conditioned relative response
registration_metadata_assumption: model_parameter_bytes is known before performance profiling; only this static JSON field is extracted from the frozen DB
probe_cost_note: GPU wall uses measured wall_seconds × GPU count; wall_seconds already includes load_seconds and compute_seconds
full_anchor_reference_note: Uses all held-out anchor outcomes; 100% anchor budget on the same scored subset
external_note: Same held-out model and k=8 main-campaign probes; no external workload performance probe
